description: Header file defining the SoundDoseManager class and related classes for managing sound dose and MEL processing in Android audio framework.

classes.name: SoundDoseManager
classes.description: Manages sound dose calculations, MEL processing, and interfaces with Android audio HAL.

classes.name: SoundDose
classes.description: Inner class implementing the ISoundDose interface and handling binder death.

classes.name: HalSoundDoseCallback
classes.description: Inner class implementing HAL callback for sound dose events.

methods.name: getOrCreateProcessorForDevice
methods.description: Creates or retrieves MEL processor for a specific device and stream.

methods.name: removeStreamProcessor
methods.description: Removes MEL processor for a given stream handle.

methods.name: setOutputRs2UpperBound
methods.description: Sets the upper bound for RS2 momentary exposure warnings.

methods.name: getSoundDoseInterface
methods.description: Registers callback and returns the ISoundDose interface.

methods.name: setHalSoundDoseInterface
methods.description: Sets the HAL sound dose interface for MEL computation.

methods.name: getIdForAudioDevice
methods.description: Returns cached audio port id for a given audio device.

methods.name: mapAddressToDeviceId
methods.description: Maps device address to device id.

methods.name: clearMapDeviceIdEntries
methods.description: Clears device id map entries for a given device.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Returns a string dump of internal state.

methods.name: getCachedMelRecordsSize
methods.description: Returns size of cached MEL records (testing).

methods.name: forceComputeCsdOnAllDevices
methods.description: Forces CSD computation on all devices.
